name: salvage-gzip-missing-trailer
description: A gzip stream whose 8-byte trailer (CRC32 + ISIZE) never arrived: every payload byte is recoverable, only the integrity footer is missing.
grounding: A capture cut off in flight is still most of a turn. Refusing it would discard everything the stream did deliver in exchange for nothing — but the salvage is reported, so a recovered reduction is never silently indistinguishable from a clean one.
